$comment: India Species Atlas: 60-second vertical reel. This file is the source of truth for the edit. The Remotion composition AtlasReel reads it (video/atlas-promo/reel/). Times are seconds at 30 fps. Voice times are PLANNED and are replaced by the measured times of the human recording (see reel/audio/voice/VOICE_SCRIPT.md). status: test-standin | awaiting-flow | existing-adapt | approved | rejected.

safeZone.note: Instagram UI covers roughly the top 220 px, the bottom 440 px (caption and buttons) and a 120 px column on the right. Critical type stays inside this box.

voice.line: India is home to some of the most extraordinary species on Earth.
But where they live... is only the beginning.
voice.emotion: intrigued, a smile in the voice

voice.claim: great-indian-bustard threatNote: "loss and fragmentation of grassland"

voice.line: And sometimes, the threat is literally a line across the landscape.
voice.emotion: serious, the key line of the film
voice.claim: great-indian-bustard threatNote: "Collision with high-tension power lines crossing the Thar"

voice.line: Move south, and the story changes.

voice.claim: bengal-tiger threatNote: "fragmentation of forest and corridors"
bengal-tiger threatNote: "loss and fragmentation of forest and corridors by roads, railways, mining and settlement"

voice.line: Even here, dams and barrages split the population.
voice.claim: ganges-river-dolphin threatNote: "Dams and barrages fragment the population"

voice.line: Different habitat. Different species. Different pressures.
And some stories show us something else.

voice.claim: indian-rhinoceros summary: "A conservation success story ... but still Vulnerable because of its small, concentrated range"

voice.line: That's why we built India Species Atlas.
Not just to show where species are...
...but to explore what is happening there.
voice.emotion: warm, to camera, the last spoken line

shots.visual: Black. A 1 px canvas-coloured line rules across, then traces India's outline from the site's boundary file; INDIA in Newsreader Light. Re-rendered in portrait from S01Signal/S02India, not cropped from the 16:9 film.
shots.character: 0.5 s side-profile silhouette in the dark at the line's start, rim-lit by it, before the outline draws.
sfx: geographic click as the line starts
shots.transitionOut: F camera dive (push into India)

shots.visual: The existing map camera travels to the Thar (LANDSCAPE_FOCUS[0]); relief and contours come up, the line runs ahead into Rajasthan. Final 0.6 s: contour lines thicken into terrain and a contour-shaped mask opens onto the grassland plate.
shots.transitionOut: I mask reveal (contour mask opens on S03)

shots.visual: Vertical tracking shot through pale golden semi-arid grassland at sunrise, grass-tip height. No animals.
shots.character: Small distant figure on a low rise, back to camera, 0.8 s (7.6 to 8.4).
shots.transitionOut: H match cut (horizon line holds height into S04)

shots.visual: Grass-level lateral track; one dark transmission wire crosses frame towards distant pylons; focus racks grass to wire. Freeze 4 frames at 12.87; a canvas-coloured graphic line lays over the wire and straightens into a map line.
shots.character: In the foreground, out of focus, raises an arm and points at the wire (11.0 to 12.2).
sfx: short tonal whoosh on the morph
shots.transitionOut: A line morph (wire to map line)

shots.visual: A Great Indian Bustard stands in open grassland at sunrise; slow push from a respectful distance. The map line from S04 settles to the horizon and fades.
shots.character: At the left edge, partly hidden by foreground grass, watching the bird (14.0 to 15.2). Never in front of it.
sfx: single soft low impact on the status
shots.transitionIn: A line morph (line resolves onto the horizon)
shots.transitionOut: K focus transition (bird to card)
shots.honesty: A generated bustard is an image of no real bird. Prefer the credited Commons photograph or licensed real footage; if a Flow bird is used, the frame carries an on-screen 'AI-generated visualisation' label. Decision pending (EDIT_PLAN.md, open decision 1).

shots.visual: Portrait species card: number, name, status chip from species.ts. Rajasthan and Gujarat (states of record) fill in the bustard's status colour on the map.
shots.character: Points at Rajasthan on the map (17.6 to 18.8).
sfx: UI tick on each line of type
shots.transitionOut: E habitat morph, then G camera ascent

shots.visual: Camera advances into dry deciduous forest; sun shafts through canopy. No animals.
sfx: deep impact on the cut to S08
shots.transitionIn: G camera ascent then dive into canopy
shots.transitionOut: H match cut (vertical tree trunk to tiger's stripe)

shots.visual: Tiger walks through forest, tracked from the side.
shots.character: 0.7 s, half-hidden behind a trunk in the foreground, looking towards the tiger (22.6 to 23.3).
shots.transitionOut: G camera ascent to map
shots.honesty: As S05. The existing credited 3840 px tiger photograph is the fallback.

shots.visual: Portrait species card; the tiger's states of record fill; a line traces the dataset's localities (the smoothPath device the site uses). It is not drawn or labelled as a range or a corridor.
shots.character: Traces along the line with a finger; the line draws just behind the fingertip (24.6 to 26.4).
shots.transitionOut: B road morph in reverse (line becomes the road's centre line)

shots.visual: High aerial along a highway cutting through dense forest; forest on both sides.
sfx: low mechanical sweep on the morph
shots.transitionOut: B road morph (centre line lifts off as a line, splits in two)

shots.visual: Slow aerial over the broad river at early morning; mist.
shots.transitionIn: the split line becomes the river's two banks (match)
shots.transitionOut: camera tips under the surface

shots.visual: Turbid water, suspended sediment; the dolphin passes.
shots.character: Under 1 s, drawn as a line-art figure inside sonar rings, an Atlas-style visualisation rather than a person underwater (33.4 to 34.2).
shots.transitionOut: C river morph
shots.honesty: No licensed video of the species exists on Commons. If generated, the visualisation label applies. The credited photograph is the fallback.

shots.visual: Portrait card; the Natural Earth river network draws outward from the Ganga; the dolphin's states of record fill.
shots.transitionOut: D contour morph (camera climbs north into relief)

shots.visual: Aerial glide towards a rocky ridge at dawn; blowing snow.
shots.transitionIn: D contour morph (relief to real ridge)
shots.transitionOut: H match cut (ridge line to slope line)

shots.visual: Snow leopard moves across a rocky slope, tracked from far away.
shots.character: Small figure lower in frame, looking up towards the cat (39.4 to 40.2).
shots.transitionOut: D contour morph (the ridge becomes a contour line)
shots.honesty: Wild NCF India footage (CC BY 3.0) was found by the earlier plan and is the preferred source if it passes the 1080p gate.

shots.visual: Portrait card over the baked contour raster; one contour expands outward; the snow leopard's states of record fill (Ladakh drawn inside Jammu and Kashmir, as the site does).
shots.transitionOut: J scale transition (contour to tall grass blade)

shots.visual: Greater one-horned rhinoceros walks through tall floodplain grass; lateral track.
shots.character: 0.7 s at the frame edge, a small relieved smile that settles into thought (44.0 to 44.7).
shots.transitionOut: G camera ascent to the master map
shots.honesty: Captive or unverified footage is not approved for this shot (see PROMO_FILM_PLAN.md T10).

shots.visual: Whole India in portrait framing (upper two-thirds). Five places light in film order; one thin line joins them as the route this film travelled. It is the film's own path, not an ecological connection.
shots.character: Stands beside the map, lower left, watching the network light up; turns her head as each place lights.
sfx: a low bloom when the route completes
shots.transitionOut: J scale transition into the interface map pane

shots.visual: Six real-site plates at 0.8 s each, re-cropped for portrait: ATLAS (atlas.jpg), SPECIES (species.jpg), PROFILE (profile-overview.jpg), DISTRIBUTION (profile-distribution.jpg), THREATS (profile-threats.jpg), LAYERS (atlas-conservation.jpg). Masked reveals, directional blur, slight perspective.
shots.character: Taps the Threats tab on the PROFILE plate (52.0 to 52.6); the tab's real state follows.
sfx: precise UI ticks on every cut
shots.transitionOut: camera pulls back out of the interface to the map

shots.visual: Back to the quiet map; everything slows. Character fully visible, mid-frame below the map.
shots.character: Fully visible. Turns from the map to camera on 'there'.
shots.transitionOut: fade through black

shots.visual: Black. Thin line. India outline. INDIA SPECIES ATLAS. Then the three EXPLORE lines. One clean impact.
shots.character: A last look to camera, small and calm, beside the wordmark (58.4 to 59.4).
sfx: one final impact on the wordmark
shots.transitionOut: end
